|translation='''Title:''' Yaggle Gakkle.

'''Card text:''' Target a creature vehicle at the same location as a creature. If ferocity exceeds the target's maneuver plus landspeed, the creature vehicle is eaten. Add 2 to the creature's ferocity (cumulative).

Title prints a Japanese comma (ヤッグル、ガックル) for the English space. Lore omits English girl and uses 位置 for site. +2 ferocity is a following sentence, not attached to the eaten clause.

'''Lore:''' Calm down. Hey! Calm down. What is it? Did you smell something?

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese comma (ヤッグル、ガックル) for the English space.
